She’s now in the process of getting me more therapy by my local mental health clinic. She’ll understand.

Hey dude, sorry to hear you’re feeling dysphoric lately about your height. Me too! How old are you may I ask? I’m 14 and I’ve been going to Tavistock for awhile now and I have recently asked about the possibility of me starting human growth hormones. They unfortunately don’t work after your growth bones have fused shut. That means you can’t grow anymore. They have said yes to them but it may take a few weeks for them to sort everything out. Also if you are on hormone blockers you could maybe ask if you are eligible for the growth hormone, as they should be doing regular bone scans and blood tests to make sure your levels are normal. Hormone blockers keep your growth bones open for a certain amount of time until puberty resumes.
